block.name: Linear
block.description: Interact with Linear issues, projects, and more
block.longDescription: Integrate Linear into the workflow. Can manage issues, comments, projects, labels, workflow states, cycles, attachments, and more. Can also trigger workflows based on Linear webhook events.
